brief: Goldman's TMT conference day one, recapped by the bank's US and European sales and trading desks. The desks report that presenting managements reiterated or raised guidance, so the tone was bullish. The chain the note argues: agentic AI raises compute and bandwidth intensity, so infrastructure demand exceeds supply, so vendors reaffirm multi-year targets. Broadcom held FY27 and FY28 AI revenue targets of $115bn and $230bn with supply constrained and the binding constraint now power, permitting and construction rather than demand. Cisco tied a 5x rise in agent bandwidth use to $9.3bn of FY26 hyperscaler AI orders and a 15% F2027 revenue growth midpoint. Arista, Qualcomm, Infineon and Nebius each described supply-limited demand. OpenAI said newer models cut output tokens 68%, moving buyers to cost per task, and that an 80% price cut on an older model lifted usage 10x, which the desk reads as Jevons paradox rather than deflation. Enterprise adoption is early, with Databricks noting few firms run agents at scale. Visa, eBay, Reddit and Airbnb reported resilient consumer demand and engagement. The desk conclusion is to stay long AI infrastructure into 2027 while monetization across the value chain remains early.
